expectation: Membrane ring on a subset of cells (cytotoxic T cells, dimmer NK/DC), a minority of cells, scattered single cells in most tissue and clustered in T-rich zones, sitting within CD3+ cells.
observed: A: discrete yellow cells in every core, sparse in some and dense in others, with no haze. B/C: sparse isolated bright cells on dim nuclei. D: ring-like membrane cells. E: crisp membrane-rimmed cells, mostly white (CD3+) in the merge, in CD3-rich areas.
why: A distinct minority of cells shows membrane-ringed CD8a signal that is mostly CD3-positive and varies in density between cores, with no haze or uniform grain.
notes: CD8a marks discrete membrane-ringed cells, scattered in sparse cores and clustered in CD3-rich ones. In row E most of them are white in the merge, so they lie on CD3+ cells. Background is clean.
